sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for the filter controls
sections.what: Brings in the type for the filter component, the audience, kind and status labels, the capex band label, and helpers for finding a signal's country, region, industry and locations. Nothing appears on screen from this section itself.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the filter labels and place logic in step with the rest of the map.
sections.watch_out: The UNMAPPED marker is shared with other files, so changing it affects every place that uses it.

sections.name: SelectFilter, CAPEX_OPTIONS, typeOptions, strings
sections.title: Reusable dropdown and shared option lists
sections.what: Provides the dropdown component used across the opportunity filters. It also builds the list of capex size bands, including a megaproject band for projects of at least one billion US dollars, and builds the list of signal types, hiding excluded types unless a signal already uses them. A final helper makes sorted, unique option lists from plain text.
sections.why: Likely reason: one dropdown style keeps all filters consistent and makes them easy to test by a fixed test id.
sections.watch_out: The test id for each dropdown is built from its label text, so renaming a label also changes the test id.

sections.name: DetailedFilters
sections.title: Detailed filter panel
sections.what: Shows the full set of filters for opportunities: industry, capex, solution, trigger, confidence, priority tier, review status, audience, signal type, nature, theme, company, region and country. Options come from the current data, and regions and countries also come from the locations of the signals shown. A short note says the filters work together.
sections.why: Likely reason: gives analysts precise control over the list and map. The note warns that industries include client sectors as well as research industries.
sections.watch_out: Region and country options come from the signals shown, so choosing one filter can remove options from the others. The helper that builds industry options is used here but not defined in the visible code.

summary: The import section for the Opportunity Map filters. The filter components themselves are not in the packet.
purpose: Brings in the labels, filter helpers and types that the filter controls use.
why: Likely reason: keeps filter labels and region or country logic the same as the rest of the map.
how: 1. Imports labels for audience, kind and status. 2. Imports helpers that find a country, region, industry and locations for a signal. 3. Imports the capex band label and the filter type. Nothing runs at this point.
inputs: Not applicable. This section only loads definitions from other modules.
outputs: Names that the rest of the file can use. Nothing appears on screen from this section.
risks: UNMAPPED is a shared marker used by other files, so changing its value affects every filter that depends on it. Only the imports were supplied, so the filter logic is unverified.
debug: If a filter option is missing, check the labels and helpers in the filters and omApi modules. If a build fails on an import, check the exported names in those modules.
